en.s: The Battle of Marj Rahit (Arabic: معركة مرج راهط) was a minor conflict fought between the Ghassanid Arab allies of Byzantine Empire and the Rashidun army under the command of Khalid bin Walid in April 634. The morning after the Battle of Huwwarin, Khalid moved his army of 9000 towards Damascus. Approximately 20 miles from Damascus there lies a pass with an elevation of 2000 feet above the surrounding countryside.

zh.s: 马尔杰拉希特战役（阿拉伯语：معركة مرج راهط）是634年4月拜占庭帝国的阿拉伯加萨尼德盟友与哈立德·伊本·瓦利德指挥的正统哈里发军队之间的一场小规模冲突。胡瓦林战役次日，哈立德率领9000人向大马士革进军。距大马士革约20英里处有一条山口，海拔比周围地势高出2000英尺。

en.s: The siege of Oudenaarde took place in 1452. It was one of the major engagements in the Revolt of Ghent (1449–53). The city was besieged by forces of the rebellious city of Ghent and defended by forces led by Simon de Lalaing, one of the leading captains of Philip the Good, Duke of Burgundy. The siege included one of the largest artillery bombardments then seen in Europe.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1452年，根特起义期间发生奥德纳尔德围城战，是1449—1453年根特起义中的一场主要战役。起义城市根特派兵围攻奥德纳尔德，勃艮第公爵菲利普三世的主要将领西蒙·德·拉兰指挥守军。围城期间，双方进行了当时欧洲规模最大的炮击之一。

en.s: The Battle of Yenişehir took place between Yavuz Sultan Selim and his brother, Şehzade Ahmed, in 1513. It was the last conflict of the Ottoman Civil War (1509–1513), as Selim's victory secured his legitimacy as Sultan of the Ottoman Empire.

zh.s: 1513年，新谢希尔发生了塞利姆一世与其兄弟沙赫扎德·艾哈迈德之间的战斗。这是1509—1513年奥斯曼内战的最后一场战斗。塞利姆获胜后，作为奥斯曼帝国苏丹的合法地位得到巩固。

en.s: The Battle of Sahart was fought on April 24, 1541 between the army of Emperor Gelawdewos and the forces of Garad Emar, a lieutenant of Imam Ahmad ibn Ibrahim al-Ghazi. According to Ethiopian sources, Gelawdewos was defeated. Gelawdewos succeeded to the throne soon after his father's death on 2 September 1540. Despite his youth, over the next few months he made several successful attacks on the Somali garrisons in northern Ethiopia. These lifted the morale of the restive Christian Ethiopians, and upon arriving in Semien, he was surrounded by the apostates and others who had joined the Imam who sought his clemency.

zh.s: 萨哈特战役于1541年4月24日爆发，交战双方是格劳德沃斯皇帝的军队和伊玛目艾哈迈德·伊本·易卜拉欣·加齐的副将加拉德·埃马尔所率部队。埃塞俄比亚史料称格劳德沃斯战败。他于父亲1540年9月2日去世后不久继位。尽管年纪尚轻，他在接下来的几个月里多次成功袭击埃塞俄比亚北部的索马里驻军，鼓舞了不满的埃塞俄比亚基督徒。抵达塞米恩后，他被叛教者及其他投靠伊玛目的人包围；这些人寻求他的宽恕。

en.s: The Battle of Mühlberg took place near Mühlberg in the Electorate of Saxony in 1547, during the Schmalkaldic War. The Catholic princes of the Holy Roman Empire led by the Holy Roman Emperor Charles V decisively defeated the Lutheran Schmalkaldic League of Protestant princes under the command of Elector John Frederick I of Saxony and Landgrave Philip I of Hesse.

zh.s: 施马尔卡尔登战争期间，1547年，米尔贝格战役在萨克森选侯国的米尔贝格附近爆发。查理五世皇帝率领神圣罗马帝国的天主教诸侯，决定性地击败了由萨克森选帝侯约翰·腓特烈一世和黑森伯爵菲利普一世指挥的路德宗施马尔卡尔登新教诸侯联盟。

en.t: Battle of the Strait of Gibraltar (1590)
en.s: The First Battle of the Strait of Gibraltar was a naval engagement that took place on 24 April 1590 during the Anglo-Spanish War. Ten English armed merchant vessels of the Levant Company were met and intercepted by twelve Spanish galleys under Pedro de Acuña in the service of Spain in the region of the Gibraltar Straits. English sources claim that the English were able to repel the galleys inflicting heavy losses after a six-hour fight, while Spanish sources show the battle as indecisive.

zh.s: 1590年4月24日，第一次直布罗陀海峡海战在英西战争期间爆发。十艘武装商船由英国黎凡特公司经营，在直布罗陀海峡附近遭到佩德罗·德·阿库尼亚率领的十二艘西班牙桨帆船拦截。英国史料称，经过六小时交战，英船击退西班牙桨帆船并使其遭受重大损失；西班牙史料则认为战斗没有分出胜负。

en.s: The siege of Calais of 1596, also known as the Spanish conquest of Calais, took place at the strategic port-city of Calais (present-day northern France), between 8 and 24 April 1596, as part of the Franco-Spanish War (1595–1598), in the context of the French Wars of Religion.

zh.s: 1596年加莱围城战又称西班牙征服加莱，发生于1596年4月8日至24日。战场是战略港口城市加莱（今法国北部），这场围城战是1595—1598年法西战争的一部分，也发生在法国宗教战争期间。

en.s: The Relief of Genoa took place between 28 March 1625 and 24 April 1625, during the Thirty Years' War. It was a major naval expedition launched by Spain against the French-occupied Republic of Genoa, whose capital, Genoa, was being besieged by a joint Franco-Savoyard army composed of 30,000 men and 3,000 cavalry.

zh.s: 三十年战争期间，西班牙于1625年3月28日至4月24日发动大规模海上远征，解救被围困的热那亚共和国。热那亚首都热那亚当时正遭到由法国和萨伏依组成的联军围攻，联军有3万步兵和3000名骑兵。

en.s: The Savoyard–Waldensian wars were a series of conflicts between the community of Waldensians (also known as Vaudois) and the Savoyard troops in the Duchy of Savoy from 1655 to 1690. The Piedmontese Easter in 1655 sparked the conflict. It was largely a period of persecution of the Waldensian Church, rather than a military conflict. Joshua Janavel (1617–1690) was one of the Waldensian military leaders against the Savoyard ducal troops.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1655年至1690年，萨伏依公国军队与瓦勒度派社群（又称沃州派）之间发生一系列冲突。冲突由1655年的“皮埃蒙特复活节”引发。这段时期主要是瓦勒度派教会遭受迫害，而非持续的军事冲突。约书亚·雅纳韦尔（1617—1690年）是反抗萨伏依公爵军队的瓦勒度派军事领袖之一。

en.s: The siege of Bonn took place in 1703 during the War of the Spanish Succession when an Allied force laid siege to and forced the surrender of the French garrison of the city of Bonn. The Allied forces were part of a general field army commanded by John Churchill, 1st Duke of Marlborough. The siege was portrayed in a contemporaneous painting by Alexander van Gaelen.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 西班牙王位继承战争期间，1703年，盟军围攻波恩，迫使城内法国守军投降。盟军隶属于约翰·丘吉尔、第一代马尔伯勒公爵指挥的主力野战军。亚历山大·范·盖伦曾在一幅同时代画作中描绘这场围城战。

en.t: The first regular newspaper in British Colonial America, The Boston News-Letter, is published
en.s: The Boston News-Letter, first published on April 24, 1704, is regarded as the first continuously published newspaper in the colony of Massachusetts. It was heavily subsidized by the British government, with a limited circulation. All copies were approved by the Royal governor before publication. The colonies’ first newspaper was Publick Occurrences Both Forreign and Domestick, which published its first and only issue on September 25, 1690.

zh.t: 英属北美殖民地首份定期报纸《波士顿新闻通讯》创刊
zh.s: 《波士顿新闻通讯》于1704年4月24日创刊，被认为是马萨诸塞殖民地第一份连续发行的报纸。该报得到英国政府大量补助，发行量有限，出版前每一期都须经皇家总督批准。殖民地的第一份报纸是《国内外公共事件》，于1690年9月25日发行唯一一期。

en.s: The Action of 24 April 1715 was a battle took place on 24 April 1715, during the Great Northern War. It was a victory for a Danish squadron under Gabel, which captured five of the six Swedish ships under Wachtmeister at the cost of 65 dead and 224 wounded.

zh.s: 1715年4月24日发生的战斗是大北方战争中的一场海战。加贝尔率领的丹麦分舰队获胜，俘获了瓦赫特迈斯特指挥的六艘瑞典舰船中的五艘，丹麦方面有65人死亡、224人受伤。

en.s: The Battle of Liverpool took place on 24 April 1778 during the American Revolutionary War. The raid involved the British vessel HMS Blonde and the French 24-gun frigate Duc de Choiseul.

zh.s: 美国独立战争期间，利物浦海战于1778年4月24日爆发。此次突袭涉及英国军舰“金发号”和法国24炮护卫舰“肖瓦瑟尔公爵号”。

en.s: The North Channel Naval Duel was a single-ship action between the Continental Navy sloop-of-war Ranger (Captain John Paul Jones) and the Royal Navy sloop-of-war Drake (Captain George Burdon) on the evening of 24 April 1778. Fought in the North Channel, separating Ireland from Scotland, it was the first American naval success within Atlantic waters and also one of the only American naval victories in the conflict achieved without an overwhelming superiority of force.

zh.s: 北海峡海战于1778年4月24日晚发生，是一场单舰交战。美国大陆海军“游骑兵号”战帆船由约翰·保罗·琼斯船长指挥，英国皇家海军“德雷克号”战帆船由乔治·伯登船长指挥。交战地点位于北海峡，即分隔爱尔兰和苏格兰的海峡。这是美国海军在大西洋水域取得的首场胜利，也是这场战争中少数未凭借压倒性兵力优势取胜的海战之一。

en.s: The siege of Šabac in 1788 was a military engagement that took place during the Austro-Turkish War of 1788–1791, in which Habsburg Austrian forces under General Anton Ferdinand Mittrowsky captured the Ottoman-held fortress of Šabac after a three-day siege and bombardment.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1788年奥土战争期间，哈布斯堡奥地利军队在安东·费迪南德·米特罗夫斯基将军率领下，围困由奥斯曼帝国控制的沙巴茨要塞。经过三天围城和炮击，奥军攻占要塞。

en.s: In the Battle of Villers-en-Cauchies, fought on 24 April 1794, a small Anglo-Austrian cavalry force routed a vastly more numerous French division during the Flanders Campaign of the French Revolutionary Wars. Villers-en-Cauchies is 15 km south of Valenciennes.

zh.s: 维莱尔昂科希战役于1794年4月24日进行，是法国革命战争中佛兰德斯战役的一部分。一支人数较少的英奥联军骑兵击溃了人数远多于己方的法国师级部队。维莱尔昂科希位于瓦朗谢讷以南15公里。

en.t: 1798–99 United States House of Representatives elections
en.s: The 1798–99 United States House of Representatives elections were held on various dates in various states between April 24, 1798, in New York and August 1, 1799, in Tennessee. Each state set its own date for its elections to the House of Representatives, with some after the official start of the 6th United States Congress on March 4, 1799, but before the start of the first session of this Congress in Philadelphia on December 2, 1799.

zh.s: 1798至1799年美国众议院选举在各州分别举行，最早于1798年4月24日在纽约开始，最晚于1799年8月1日在田纳西结束。各州自行设定选举日期，有些选举在第六届美国国会于1799年3月4日正式开始后、同年12月2日在费城举行首次会议前举行。

en.s: The United Irish Uprising in Newfoundland was a failed mutiny by Irish soldiers in the British garrison in St. John's, Newfoundland on 24 April 1800. The authorities attributed it to the influence and example of the United Irishmen and their rebellion in Ireland two years prior.

zh.t: 纽芬兰联合爱尔兰人起义
zh.s: 纽芬兰联合爱尔兰人起义是一次未遂兵变，于1800年4月24日在纽芬兰圣约翰斯的英国驻军中发生。官方将兵变归因于联合爱尔兰人组织的影响，以及该组织两年前在爱尔兰发动叛乱所起的示范作用。

en.t: The United States Library of Congress is established when President John Adams signs legislation to appropriate $5,000 to purchase "such books as may be necessary for the use of Congress"
en.s: The Library of Congress (LOC) is a research library in Washington, D.C., serving as the library and research service for the United States Congress and the de facto national library of the United States. It also administers copyright law through the United States Copyright Office, and it houses the Congressional Research Service. Founded in 1800, the Library of Congress is the oldest federal cultural institution in the United States.

zh.t: 美国国会图书馆成立：约翰·亚当斯总统签署法案，拨款5000美元购买“国会所需的书籍”
zh.s: 美国国会图书馆（LOC）是位于华盛顿特区的研究型图书馆，为美国国会提供图书馆和研究服务，实际上也承担美国国家图书馆的职能。该馆还通过美国版权局管理版权法，并设有国会研究处。国会图书馆创建于1800年，是美国历史最悠久的联邦文化机构。

en.t: 1804–05 United States House of Representatives elections
en.s: The 1804–05 United States House of Representatives elections were held on various dates in various states between April 24, 1804 (in New York), and August 5, 1805 (in Tennessee). Each state set its own date for its elections to the House of Representatives before the first session of the 9th United States Congress convened on December 2, 1805. The elections occurred at the same time as President Thomas Jefferson's re-election.

zh.s: 1804至1805年美国众议院选举在各州分别举行，最早于1804年4月24日在纽约开始，最晚于1805年8月5日在田纳西结束。各州自行设定众议院选举日期，选举均在第九届美国国会于1805年12月2日召开首次会议之前完成。选举与托马斯·杰斐逊总统连任的竞选同期举行。

en.s: The Battle of Neumarkt-Sankt Veit on 24 April 1809 saw a Franco-Bavarian force led by Marshal Jean-Baptiste Bessières face an Austrian Empire army commanded by Johann von Hiller. Hiller's numerically superior force won a victory over the Allied troops, forcing Bessières to retreat to the west. Neumarkt-Sankt Veit is located ten kilometers north of Mühldorf and 33 kilometers southeast of Landshut in Bavaria. On 10 April 1809, Archduke Charles, Duke of Teschen's surprise invasion of the Kingdom of Bavaria put the Grande Armée of Emperor Napoleon I of France at a disadvantage.

zh.t: 诺伊马克特-圣福伊特战役
zh.s: 1809年4月24日，若望-巴蒂斯特·贝西埃元帅率领的法巴联军与约翰·冯·希勒指挥的奥地利帝国军队在诺伊马克特-圣福伊特交战。人数占优的奥军击败联军，迫使贝西埃向西撤退。诺伊马克特-圣福伊特位于巴伐利亚，距米尔多夫以北10公里、兰茨胡特东南33公里。1809年4月10日，特申公爵、奥地利大公查理突然入侵巴伐利亚王国，使法国皇帝拿破仑一世的大军陷入不利局面。

en.s: The Battle of the Basque Roads, also known as the Battle of Aix Roads (French: Bataille de l'île d'Aix, also Affaire des brûlots, rarely Bataille de la rade des Basques), was a major naval battle of the Napoleonic Wars, fought in the narrow Basque Roads at the mouth of the Charente River on the Biscay coast of France.

zh.s: 巴斯克路海战又称艾克斯海峡海战（法语：Bataille de l’île d’Aix，也称Affaire des brûlots，较少称Bataille de la rade des Basques），是拿破仑战争期间的一场重要海战，战场位于法国比斯开湾沿岸、夏朗德河入海口狭窄的巴斯克路水域。

en.t: 1810–11 United States House of Representatives elections
en.s: The 1810–11 United States House of Representatives elections were held on various dates in various states between April 24, 1810, and August 2, 1811. Each state set its own date for its elections to the House of Representatives before the first session of the 12th United States Congress convened on November 4, 1811. They occurred during President James Madison's first term.

zh.s: 1810至1811年美国众议院选举在各州分别举行，时间从1810年4月24日至1811年8月2日。各州自行设定众议院选举日期，选举在第十二届美国国会于1811年11月4日召开首次会议之前完成。选举举行时，詹姆斯·麦迪逊正处于首个总统任期。

en.t: The great fire in Surat, India causes more than 500 deaths and destruction of more than 9,000 houses
en.s: In April 1837, a fire broke out in the Indian city of Surat, then under British East India Company rule. It resulted in more than 500 deaths and the destruction of 9,737 houses in a 9+3⁄4-mile (16 km) radius. It was the most destructive fire in the history of the city.

zh.t: 印度苏拉特大火，造成500多人死亡、9000多所房屋被毁
zh.s: 1837年4月，印度城市苏拉特发生大火，当时该城由英国东印度公司统治。火灾造成500多人死亡，半径9又3/4英里（16公里）范围内的9737所房屋被毁。这是该市历史上破坏性最大的一场火灾。

en.s: The Mary Carver Affair occurred in April 1842 when the American merchant ship Mary Carver was attacked by Bereby warriors in canoes near the kraal of Little Bereby Ivory Coast. After the crew was massacred, the natives plundered the ship, provoking a response by warships of the United States Navy's African Slave Trade Patrol.

zh.s: 1842年4月，美国商船“玛丽·卡弗号”在科特迪瓦小贝雷比村附近遭到乘独木舟出击的贝雷比武士袭击。船员被杀害后，当地人劫掠船只，促使美国海军非洲反奴隶贸易巡逻队派军舰进行报复。

en.s: The 1848 general election held on 23 and 24 April 1848 elected the Constituent Assembly of the new Republic. Over 9 million voters were eligible to vote in the first French election since 1792 held under male universal suffrage.

zh.s: 1848年4月23日至24日举行法国大选，选出新共和国的制宪议会。这是法国自1792年以来首次在男性普选权制度下举行选举，共有900多万选民具备投票资格。

en.s: The Storming of Freiburg (German: Sturm auf Freiburg) took place on 24 April 1848 during the Baden Revolution. Units of the VIII Army Corps of the German Confederation stormed the town of Freiburg im Breisgau, which was occupied by republican volunteers (Freischärlern).

zh.s: 弗赖堡强攻战（德语：Sturm auf Freiburg）于1848年4月24日在巴登革命期间爆发。德意志邦联第八军团部队攻入弗赖堡市，当时该城由共和派志愿军占据。

en.s: The Skirmish of Oversø near Flensburg (now part of Germany) was a German victory of the Danish forces in the struggle for Schleswig-Holstein. The German forces included contingents from the Kingdom of Hanover and Duchy of Mecklenburg.

en.s: The Battle of Newton's Station was an engagement on April 24, 1863, in Newton's Station, Mississippi, during Grierson's Raid of the American Civil War. Union cavalry raiders under the command of Col. Benjamin Grierson, in an effort to disrupt Confederate communications, probed deep in enemy territory and entered the town of Newton's Station (now Newton). They succeeded in securing the town without any serious fighting, and captured two Confederate trains. The raiders also destroyed several miles of railroad track and telegraph wires in the vicinity, severing communications between Confederate-held Vicksburg and the Eastern Theatre commanders.

zh.s: 美国内战期间，吉里森突袭行动中的牛顿车站战役于1863年4月24日在密西西比州牛顿车站（今牛顿）发生。联邦军骑兵袭击部队由本杰明·吉里森上校指挥，深入敌方领土，试图破坏邦联军通信。他们几乎没有遇到战斗就控制了该镇，并俘获两列邦联军列车。联邦军还摧毁了附近数英里的铁路和电报线，切断了由邦联军控制的维克斯堡与东部战区指挥官之间的通信。

en.s: The Rangitikei by-election, 1875 was a by-election held on 24 April 1875 during the 5th New Zealand Parliament in the Rangitikei electorate on the West Coast of the North Island. The by-election was held because of the resignation of sitting MP and previous Premier William Fox in order to pay an extended visit to England. This election saw John Ballance narrowly win the seat by just seven votes over his main opponent, William Hogg Watt who had represented the Rangitikei electorate from 1866 to 1868 when he resigned. Conservative George Hutchison also ran.

en.s: The Battle of Fish Creek (also known as the Battle of Tourond's Coulée), fought April 24, 1885 at Fish Creek, Saskatchewan, was a major Métis victory over the Canadian forces attempting to quell Louis Riel's North-West Rebellion. en.s: The Second Battle of Villers-Bretonneux (also Actions of Villers-Bretonneux, after the First Battles of the Somme, 1918) took place from 24 to 27 April 1918, during the German spring offensive to the east of Amiens. en.s: The First Ostend Raid (part of Operation ZO) was the first of two attacks by the Royal Navy on the German-held port of Ostend during the late spring of 1918 during the First World War. Ostend was attacked in conjunction with the neighbouring harbour of Zeebrugge on 23 April in order to block the vital strategic port of Bruges, situated 6 mi (5.2 nmi; 9.7 km) inland and ideally sited to conduct raiding operations on the British coastline and shipping lanes.

zh.s: 第一次奥斯坦德突袭（“ZO行动”的一部分）是第一次世界大战期间，英国皇家海军于1918年春末对德国占领的奥斯坦德港发动的两次袭击中的第一场。4月23日，英国同时袭击邻近的泽布吕赫港，试图封锁至关重要的布鲁日港。布鲁日位于内陆6英里（5.2海里；9.7公里）处，是袭击英国海岸和航运线路的理想据点。

en.t: Thorvald Stauning becomes premier of Denmark (first term)
en.s: Thorvald August Marinus Stauning (Danish: [ˈtsʰɒːˌvælˀ ˈstɑwne̝ŋ]; 26 October 1873 in Copenhagen – 3 May 1942) was the first social democratic prime minister of Denmark. He served as prime minister from 1924 to 1926 and again from 1929 until his death in 1942. Under Stauning's leadership, Denmark developed a social welfare state with the passage of the 1933 Social Reform Act which, according to one study, “codified, simplified and extended previous social insurance and assistance legislation.”

zh.t: 斯陶宁首次出任丹麦首相
zh.s: 1924年4月24日，托瓦尔·奥古斯特·马里努斯·斯陶宁首次出任丹麦首相，成为该国首位社会民主党籍首相。他1873年生于哥本哈根，1942年去世；首相任期先后为1924年至1926年，以及1929年至逝世。任内丹麦逐步建立社会福利国家，1933年社会改革法整合、简化并扩充了此前的社会保险与救助法规。

en.s: The 1926 FA Cup final was a football match between Bolton Wanderers and Manchester City on 24 April 1926 at Wembley Stadium in London. The showpiece match of English football's primary cup competition, the Football Association Challenge Cup (better known as the FA Cup), it was the 55th final, and the fourth at Wembley. Each team progressed through five rounds to reach the final.

zh.s: 1926年英格兰足总杯决赛于1926年4月24日在伦敦温布利球场举行，由博尔顿流浪者队对阵曼彻斯特城队。这是英格兰主要俱乐部足球杯赛足总杯第55届决赛，也是第四次在温布利球场举行。两队各自经过五轮比赛晋级决赛。

en.s: The Treaty of Berlin (German–Soviet Neutrality and Nonaggression Pact) was a treaty signed on 24 April 1926 under which Germany and the Soviet Union pledged neutrality in the event of an attack on the other by a third party for five years. The treaty reaffirmed the German–Soviet Treaty of Rapallo (1922). Ratifications for the treaty were exchanged in Berlin on 29 June 1926, and it went into effect on the same day.

zh.s: 《柏林条约》又称《德苏中立与互不侵犯条约》，于1926年4月24日签署。条约规定，如果第三方攻击德国或苏联，另一方将在五年内保持中立。该条约重申了1922年《德苏拉帕洛条约》。双方于1926年6月29日在柏林交换批准书，条约也于当天生效。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Austria on 24 April 1927. The result was a victory for the Unity List (Einheitsliste), an alliance of the Christian Social Party and the Greater German People's Party, which won 85 of the 165 seats. However this brief coalition failed to result in any larger proportion of the votes than when the CSP ran alone, losing votes to the Landbund.

zh.s: 奥地利于1927年4月24日举行议会选举。基督教社会党与大德意志人民党组成的统一名单获胜，赢得165席中的85席。不过，这次短暂的联合并未使两党获得比基督教社会党单独参选时更高比例的选票，部分选票流失给了农业联盟党。

en.s: The 1928 Brighton state by-election was held on 24 April 1928 to elect the next member for Brighton in the Victorian Legislative Assembly, following the death of incumbent MP Oswald Snowball. Snowball, an Independent Nationalist who was also the Speaker of the Victorian Legislative Assembly, died on 16 March. The by-election was won by Nationalist candidate and future premier Ian Macfarlan, who narrowly defeated feminist and housewives' advocate Eleanor Glencross.

zh.s: 维多利亚州立法议会布莱顿选区于1928年4月24日举行补选，选出奥斯瓦尔德·斯诺鲍尔议员去世后的继任者。斯诺鲍尔于3月16日去世，生前是独立民族党议员，也是维多利亚州立法议会议长。民族党候选人、后来成为州长的伊恩·麦克法兰以微弱优势击败女权主义者、家庭主妇权益倡导者埃莉诺·格伦克罗斯，当选议员。

The electoral assembly, which consisted of the bicameral legislature and 120 representatives of municipalities, assembled to elect a president. The only candidate set forth was President-Regent Konstantin Päts, who was elected president with 219 votes out of the total 240 delegates. Two delegates were absent.

en.s: The Battle of Høljarast Bridge was a military engagement between Norwegian and German forces during the Norwegian Campaign. The battle ended with a partial Norwegian defeat as they were unable to hold their lines against German advance. Norwegians managed to withdraw in order destroying the strategic bridge so Germans would not be able to use it. Germans soon built an improvised bridge in the same place they named "Brandenburg".

zh.s: 赫尔亚拉斯特桥战役是挪威战役期间挪威和德国军队之间的一场军事交战。挪威军队未能抵挡德军推进，最终部分战败。挪威人成功撤退前炸毁了具有战略意义的桥梁，防止德军使用。德国人很快在原址搭建了一座临时桥，并将其命名为“勃兰登堡”。

en.s: The Raid on Santorini took place on 24 April 1944 as part of the Mediterranean Campaign in World War II. It was conducted by the British Special Boat Service, against the mixed German and Italian garrison on the island of Santorini (Thera) in the Aegean Sea. The raid was made in tandem with similar operations at the islands of Ios, Mykonos and Amorgos that aimed to destroy Axis naval observation posts and radio stations on the Cycladic islands.

zh.s: 第二次世界大战地中海战役期间，英国特别舟艇部队于1944年4月24日突袭圣托里尼岛（锡拉岛），目标是岛上由德国和意大利军人组成的守军。此次行动与伊奥斯岛、米科诺斯岛和阿莫尔戈斯岛的类似行动同时进行，目的是摧毁基克拉泽斯群岛上的轴心国海军观察哨和无线电台。

en.s: The Battle of Niangziguan (Niangziguan Zhandou, 娘子关战斗) was a battle fought between the communists and the nationalists during the Chinese Civil War in the post World War II era and resulted in communist victory. The battle was a critical one in Zhengtai Campaign that helped to determine the outcome of the campaign. Order of battle * Nationalist (1,000 total) * Shanxi 4th Security Regiment * Communist (2,000 total) * 7th Brigade of Shanxi-Chahar-Hebei Military Region Niangziguan (literally means Women’s Pass, with Niangzi means women, and Guan means pass) was a strategically important pass that was easy to defend but difficult to attack.

zh.s: 娘子关战役是第二次世界大战后中国内战期间国共两党之间的一场战斗，以共产党获胜告终。这场战斗是正太战役的关键一役，对战役结果起到重要作用。双方兵力为：国民党军1000人，包括山西省第四保安团；共产党军2000人，包括晋察冀军区第七旅。娘子关地势险要，易守难攻。

en.s: The 1948 FA Cup final was contested by Manchester United and Blackpool at Wembley Stadium on 24 April 1948. United, who had not appeared in an FA Cup Final for 39 years, won 4–2, with two goals from Jack Rowley and one apiece from Stan Pearson and John Anderson. Eddie Shimwell and Stan Mortensen scored Blackpool's goals. With his goal, Shimwell became the first full-back to score in a Wembley cup final.

en.s: The Dominican Civil War (Spanish: Guerra Civil Dominicana) took place between April 24, 1965, and September 3, 1965, in Santo Domingo, Dominican Republic. It started when civilian and military supporters of constitutionally elected former President Juan Bosch overthrew acting President Donald Reid Cabral. The coup prompted General Elías Wessin y Wessin to organise elements of the military loyal to President Reid, known as loyalists, initiating an armed campaign against the so-called constitutionalist rebels. Allegations of foreign support for the rebels led to an American intervention in the conflict, which later transformed into an Organization of American States occupation of the country.

zh.s: 多米尼加内战于1965年4月24日至9月3日在多米尼加共和国圣多明各爆发。支持经选举产生的前总统胡安·博什的平民和军人推翻了代总统唐纳德·里德·卡布拉尔。政变后，埃利亚斯·韦辛·韦辛将军组织忠于里德总统的部队，对宪政派叛军发动武装行动。有关外国支持叛军的指控导致美国介入冲突，之后又演变为美洲国家组织占领该国。

en.t: Cosmonaut Vladimir Komarov dies in Soyuz 1 when its parachute fails to open. He is the first human to die during a space mission
en.s: Vladimir Mikhaylovich Komarov (Russian: Владимир Михайлович Комаров, IPA: [vlɐˈdʲimʲɪr mʲɪˈxajləvʲɪtɕ kəmɐˈrof]; 16 March 1927 – 24 April 1967) was a Soviet test pilot, aerospace engineer, and cosmonaut. In October 1964, he commanded Voskhod 1, the first spaceflight to carry more than one crew member. He became the first Soviet cosmonaut to fly in space twice when he was selected as the solo pilot of Soyuz 1, its first crewed test flight.

zh.t: 中国发射“东方红一号”，成为第五个用自有运载火箭将物体送入轨道的国家
zh.s: “东方红一号”（简体中文：东方红一号；繁体中文：東方紅一號；拼音：Dōngfānghóng Yīhào；字面意思为“东方红一号”）是中华人民共和国第一颗人造卫星，西方也称China 1或PRC 1。该卫星于1970年4月24日成功发射，是“东方红”计划的一部分，也属于“两弹一星”计划。

en.t: Long March 1's first flight launched China's first satellite Dong Fang Hong 1 to space on 24 April 1970
en.s: The Long March 1 (长征一号, Chángzhēng yī hào, CZ-1, DoD: CSL-1), was the first member of China's Long March rocket family. Like the U.S.'s and the Soviet Union's first rockets, it was based on a class of ballistic missiles, namely the DF-3 class. Long March 1's first flight launched China's first satellite Dong Fang Hong 1 to space on 24 April 1970.

zh.t: 长征一号首飞，将中国第一颗卫星“东方红一号”送入太空
zh.s: 长征一号（长征一号，拼音：Chángzhēng yī hào；CZ-1；美国国防部编号：CSL-1）是中国长征系列运载火箭的首个型号。与美国和苏联早期火箭相似，它以弹道导弹为基础，使用了东风三号导弹系列的技术。长征一号首飞于1970年4月24日，将中国第一颗卫星“东方红一号”送入太空。

en.s: The 1970 Haitian coup attempt, also known as the Cayard affair, was a failed coup d'état by dissident elements of the Haitian Coast Guard, led by Colonel and Coast Guard Commandant Octave Cayard, against the François Duvalier dictatorship. Hastily executed, the coup attempt was prompted by government crackdowns that rounded up alleged coup plotters, making the conspirators believe government authorities were close to discovering their plans, thus the desperate move.

zh.s: 1970年海地未遂政变又称“卡亚尔事件”，是海地海岸警卫队反对派成员发动的一次失败政变。政变由海岸警卫队司令、上校奥克塔夫·卡亚尔领导，目标是推翻弗朗索瓦·杜瓦利埃的独裁政权。政府镇压并逮捕被指策划政变的人后，阴谋者认为当局即将发现他们的计划，于是仓促发动政变。

en.s: The Maoist insurgency in Turkey, referred by the Maoists as the People's War (Turkish: Halk savaşı), is an ongoing low-level insurgency in eastern Turkey between the Turkish government and Maoist rebels that began in the early 1970s. The insurgency declined in the late 1980s and 1990s and has been sidelined by the larger Kurdish–Turkish conflict (1978–2025).

en.s: General elections were held in South Africa on 24 April 1974. They were called one year earlier than scheduled by Prime Minister John Vorster on 4 February. The House of Assembly was increased in size from 166 to 171 members. The election was once again won by the National Party, with a slightly increased parliamentary majority. en.s: The 1978 Prince Edward Island general election was held on April 24, 1978. The election was one of the closest in P.E.I. history, with the governing Liberals of Premier Alexander B. Campbell losing a number of seats to their Progressive Conservative rivals. The decrease of the 26 to 6 Liberal majority to a slim 17 to 15 lead over the PC, and the resignation of Alex Campbell, led to an unstable legislature, and another election was held just one year later in 1979.

zh.s: 爱德华王子岛于1978年4月24日举行大选，这是该省历史上竞争最激烈的选举之一。亚历山大·B·坎贝尔省长领导的自由党政府失去多个席位，进步保守党有所斩获。自由党的议席从26比6的多数优势降至仅以17比15领先进步保守党，加上亚历克斯·坎贝尔辞职，使议会局势不稳。一年后，该省再次举行选举。

en.s: General elections were held in Antigua and Barbuda on 24 April 1980. They were won by the governing Antigua Labour Party. ALP leader Vere Bird was re-elected as Prime Minister of Antigua and Barbuda. Voter turnout was 77.1%. They were the last elections before Antigua and Barbuda's independence as a Commonwealth realm in 1981.

zh.s: 安提瓜和巴布达于1980年4月24日举行大选，由执政的安提瓜工党获胜。工党领袖维尔·伯德再次当选安提瓜和巴布达总理。投票率为77.1%。这是安提瓜和巴布达于1981年作为英联邦王国独立前的最后一次选举。

en.t: End of Beacon Hill Tunnel (Hong Kong)
en.s: Beacon Hill Tunnel is a railway tunnel in Hong Kong on the original Kowloon–Canton Railway, linking Kowloon Tong to its immediate south and Sha Tin to its north. The nearest stations to the south and north of the tunnel are Kowloon Tong and Tai Wai respectively. Today, the tunnel carries the MTR East Rail line metro service and through trains to mainland China.

zh.s: 笔架山隧道是香港九龙—广州铁路原线上的铁路隧道，南接九龙塘，北通沙田。隧道南北两端最近的车站分别是九龙塘和大围。如今，隧道供港铁东铁线列车及开往中国内地的直通车使用。

en.s: General elections were held in Djibouti on 24 April 1987 to elect a President and National Assembly. In the presidential election the only candidate was incumbent Hassan Gouled Aptidon of the People's Rally for Progress, the country's sole legal party. He was re-elected with 99.23% of the vote. In the National Assembly elections the RPP put forward a list of 65 candidates for the 65 seats, which was approved by 98.6% of voters with a turnout of 88.69%.

zh.s: 吉布提于1987年4月24日举行大选，选出总统和国民议会议员。总统选举中，唯一候选人是执政党进步人民联盟的时任总统哈桑·古莱德·阿普蒂敦，他以99.23%的得票率连任。国民议会选举中，进步人民联盟提名65名候选人竞选全部65席，获得98.6%的支持率，投票率为88.69%。

en.s: The 1988 Football League Cup final (also known as the Littlewoods Challenge Cup final for sponsorship reasons) was an association football match between Arsenal and Luton Town on 24 April 1988 at Wembley Stadium, London. It was the final match of the 1987–88 staging of the Football League Cup. Luton were making their first League Cup final appearance, while the competition holders Arsenal were appearing in their fourth final.

zh.s: 1988年英格兰足球联赛杯决赛因赞助商而称“小森林杯决赛”，于1988年4月24日在伦敦温布利球场举行，由阿森纳对阵卢顿镇。这是1987—88赛季联赛杯的最后一场比赛。卢顿镇首次闯入联赛杯决赛，卫冕冠军阿森纳则第四次进入决赛。

In 1981, the Socialist Party leader, François Mitterrand, was elected President of France and the Left won the legislative election. However, in 1986, the right regained a parliamentary majority. en.s: STS-31 was the 35th mission of NASA's Space Shuttle program and the tenth flight of the Space Shuttle Discovery. The primary purpose of this mission was the deployment of the Hubble Space Telescope (HST) into low Earth orbit. Discovery lifted off from Launch Complex 39B on April 24, 1990, from Kennedy Space Center, Florida. Following the Challenger accident clarification was required on mission numbering.

zh.s: STS-31是美国国家航空航天局航天飞机计划第35次任务，也是“发现号”航天飞机第10次飞行。任务的主要目的是将哈勃太空望远镜送入近地轨道。“发现号”于1990年4月24日从佛罗里达州肯尼迪航天中心39B发射台升空。挑战者号事故后，任务编号需要作出说明。

en.s: On 24 April 1993, the Provisional Irish Republican Army (IRA) detonated a powerful truck bomb on Bishopsgate, a major thoroughfare in London's financial district, the City of London. Telephoned warnings were sent about an hour beforehand, but a news photographer was killed in the blast and 44 people were injured, with fatalities minimised due to its occurrence on a Saturday.

zh.s: 1993年4月24日，爱尔兰共和军临时派在伦敦金融区的一条主干道主教门引爆了一枚威力巨大的卡车炸弹。爆炸约一小时前有人打电话报警，但爆炸仍造成一名新闻摄影师死亡、44人受伤。由于事发当天是星期六，伤亡人数有所减少。

en.s: The 1993 WFA Cup final was the 23rd final of the Women's FA Cup, England's primary cup competition for women's football teams. The showpiece event was the last to be played under the auspices of the Women's Football Association (WFA) prior to their takeover by the Football Association (FA). The final was contested between Arsenal and Doncaster Belles on 24 April 1993 at the Manor Ground in Oxford, with highlights broadcast the following day on Channel 4.

The Final was played at Wembley Stadium, London on 24 April 1994. The match was contested by Huddersfield Town and Swansea City. zh.s: 1994年Autoglass Trophy决赛是英格兰足球联赛锦标赛第11届决赛。这项国内杯赛由英格兰足球联赛第二级和第三级球队参加。决赛于1994年4月24日在伦敦温布利球场举行，由哈德斯菲尔德镇对阵斯旺西城。双方在常规时间和加时赛中1比1战平，斯旺西最终在点球大战中以3比1获胜。

en.t: Antiterrorism and Effective Death Penalty Act of 1996
en.s: The Antiterrorism and Effective Death Penalty Act of 1996 (AEDPA), Pub. L. 104–132 (text) (PDF), 110 Stat. 1214, enacted April 24, 1996, was introduced to the United States Congress in April 1995 as a Senate Bill (S. 735). en.s: A primary election was held on Friday, 24 April 1998, to elect the prime ministerial nominee of the Spanish Socialist Workers' Party (PSOE) for the 2000 Spanish general election. zh.s: 1998年4月24日（星期五），西班牙工人社会党举行初选，选出参加2000年西班牙大选的首相候选人。1997年党代表大会后，曾多次担任部长的华金·阿尔穆尼亚接替前首相费利佩·冈萨雷斯成为新任党魁。冈萨雷斯在党代表大会开幕时出人意料地宣布，不再竞选连任总书记。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Togo on 24 April 2005, following the death in office of long-time president Gnassingbé Eyadéma. The main candidates were Eyadéma's son, Faure Gnassingbé, and opposition leader Emmanuel Bob-Akitani. The elections and the preceding period were marked by violence, with many people reported killed in various incidents. According to the official results, Gnassingbé won the election, taking slightly more than 60% of the vote. Violence flared in the capital Lomé after the results were announced, and thousands fled into neighboring countries.

zh.s: 多哥于2005年4月24日举行总统选举，此前长期执政的总统纳辛贝·埃亚德马在任内去世。主要候选人是埃亚德马之子福雷·纳辛贝和反对派领袖埃马纽埃尔·博布-阿基塔尼。选举前后发生暴力事件，据报多人在不同冲突中死亡。官方结果显示，纳辛贝赢得选举，得票略高于60%。结果公布后，首都洛美再度爆发暴力事件，数千人逃往邻国。

en.s: Three bomb attacks on the Egyptian resort city of Dahab, in the Sinai Peninsula, took place on 24 April 2006. The resort town is popular with Western tourists and Egyptians alike during the holiday season. en.s: A by-election for the Kyoto-3rd seat in the Japanese House of Representatives was held on 24 April 2016, coinciding with the by-election in Hokkaido. The seat became vacant after sitting member Kensuke Miyazaki resigned on 12 February 2016 in the midst of an extramarital affair scandal. Miyazaki, a member of the Liberal Democratic Party, served the district from 2012. He defeated Democratic Party of Japan MP Kenta Izumi by slim margins in the 2012 (0.1%) and 2014 (2.7%) elections. Izumi managed to wrest back his old seat by a landslide, eclipsing his nearest rival by 45 percentage points.

en.s: A by-election for the Hokkaido-5th seat in the Japanese House of Representatives was held on 24 April 2016, coinciding with another by-election in Kyoto. The by-election was triggered by the death of the sitting member, former Speaker of the House and Foreign Minister Nobutaka Machimura from cerebral infarction in Osaka on 1 June 2015. Machimura, a member of the Liberal Democratic Party, was a long-serving representative for the district, holding the seat almost continuously between 1996 and 2015 (except for a brief period between 2009 and 2010). The seat has been considered safe for the LDP, with Machimura retaining it on a 14.1% margin in the 2014 general election.

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Austria on 24 April 2016, with a second round run-off on 22 May 2016. However, the results of the second round were annulled and a re-vote is due to take place on 4 December 2016. The President of Austria is directly elected by universal adult suffrage once every six years. The election is held under a two-round system; if no candidate receives more than 50% of votes cast in the first round, then a second ballot occurs in which only those two candidates who received the greatest number of votes in the first round may stand.

zh.s: 洪都拉斯国家联赛和洪都拉斯杯共同安排了2019年洪都拉斯超级杯，于2019年4月24日举行，由普拉滕斯足球俱乐部对阵马拉松体育俱乐部。普拉滕斯赢得2018年洪都拉斯杯；马拉松则凭借2017—18赛季联赛最佳战绩获得参赛资格。这是洪都拉斯超级杯第二届正式赛事，也是第六届同类赛事。莫塔瓜足球俱乐部是卫冕冠军。

en.t: 2022 Tobago Council of the People's National Movement leadership election
en.s: Elections for the leadership of the Tobago Council of the People's National Movement were on April 24, 2022. For the second time, a one member, one vote voting system was adopted for all 17 positions contested since being implemented in the last election. The winner automatically became a deputy leader of the PNM at the national level.

zh.t: 2022年人民民族运动党多巴哥委员会党魁选举
zh.s: 人民民族运动党多巴哥委员会于2022年4月24日举行领导层选举。这是该党第二次对所有17个竞选职位采用“一人一票”制度，该制度于上届选举首次实施。获胜者自动成为人民民族运动党全国层面的副党魁。

en.s: On April 24, 2022, militants from Katibat Macina attacked Malian Army bases in the cities of Sévaré, Niono, and Bapho, all in central Mali's Mopti Region. The attacks killed fifteen soldiers and six civilians.

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Slovenia on 24 April 2022 to elect all 90 members of the National Assembly. The ruling Slovenian Democratic Party (SDS), led by prime minister Janez Janša, conceded and was defeated by Robert Golob and his Freedom Movement (GS). New Slovenia (NSi) placed third, and was followed by the Social Democrats (SD) and The Left (Levica), both of which suffered some losses.

zh.s: 斯洛文尼亚于2022年4月24日举行议会选举，选出全部90名国民议会议员。总理亚内兹·扬沙领导的执政党斯洛文尼亚民主党承认败选，输给罗伯特·戈洛布及其自由运动党。新斯洛文尼亚党位居第三，其后是遭遇席位流失的社会民主党和左翼党。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in France on 10 and 24 April 2022. As no candidate won a majority in the first round, a runoff was held, in which incumbent Emmanuel Macron defeated Marine Le Pen and was re-elected as President of France. Macron, from La République En Marche! (LREM), had defeated Le Pen, leader of the National Rally, once already in the 2017 French presidential election, for the term which expired on 13 May 2022.

zh.s: 法国于2022年4月10日和24日举行总统选举。首轮无人获得多数，时任总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙在第二轮击败玛丽娜·勒庞，成功连任。来自共和国前进党的马克龙在2017年总统选举中也曾击败国民阵线（现称国民联盟）领袖勒庞，任期于2022年5月13日届满。

en.s: General elections were held in the British Virgin Islands on 24 April 2023. The governing Virgin Islands Party (VIP) remained the largest party in the House of Assembly but lost its majority resulting in a hung parliament. The VIP won six seats, with the Progressive Virgin Islands Movement (PVIM) and the National Democratic Party (NDP) each winning three seats, and Progressives United (PU) winning a single seat.

zh.s: 英属维尔京群岛于2023年4月24日举行大选。执政的维尔京群岛党仍是众议院第一大党，但失去多数席位，议会因此陷入悬峙。维尔京群岛党赢得6席，进步维尔京群岛运动和国家民主党各赢得3席，联合进步党赢得1席。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in North Macedonia on 24 April 2024. Incumbent Stevo Pendarovski of the ruling centre-left Social Democrats ran for re-election to a second term. No candidate received a majority of the vote in the first round, with right-wing challenger Gordana Siljanovska-Davkova placing first by a wide margin with 41% of the vote, while Pendarovski finished second with 20% of the vote.

zh.s: 北马其顿于2024年4月24日举行总统选举。时任总统、执政中左翼社会民主联盟成员斯特沃·彭达罗夫斯基竞选连任，寻求第二个任期。首轮没有候选人获得多数，右翼挑战者戈尔达娜·西利亚诺夫斯卡-达夫科娃以41%的得票率大幅领先，彭达罗夫斯基以20%位居第二。

en.s: The 2025 Ngāti Kahungunu iwi elections were elections held on 24 April to elect the board members of Ngāti Kahungunu Iwi Incorporated, the governing body of Ngāti Kahungunu iwi. The electorate consisted of Māori who whakapapa to the iwi, a group primarily found residing on the east coast of New Zealand's North Island, including Hawke's Bay and the Wairarapa.

en.s: The 47th Moscow International Film Festival was held from 17 to 24 April 2025. Russian film director Nikita Mikhalkov was the president of the festival. Spanish film director Lluís Miñarro was head of the main jury. His Name Was Not Listed was the opening film and What We Wanted to Be was the closing film.
